rules: one shared runtime palette and panel vocabulary after entering gameplay
icon-first hotbar with text as secondary identification
long labels clip or elide instead of overlapping neighboring controls
keyboard/controller hints are compact badges rather than permanent instruction walls
player mode never renders developer diagnostics as a second HUD
development diagnostics stay compact and visibly separate from player HUD

gameplayHud.itemAuthority: equipped main-hand item drives gameplay action; tool-belt selection alone cannot conjure a tool

map.boundedExteriorRule: Home Estate minimap uses its local scene and never rebuilds a continuous-surface manifest per HUD frame

input.focusRule: one active UI surface owns action input at a time
